# Alcoa Aluminium Scaffolding

> ISO 9001:2015 aluminium scaffolding manufacturer, supplier and rental company based in Musaffah 37, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Legal name: ALCOA ALUMINIUM SCAFFOLDING - L.L.C - S.P.C. One office and warehouse (Musaffah 37); delivers to Abu Dhabi, Dubai and all emirates. Aluminium scaffolding, mobile scaffolding towers, steel cuplock scaffolding, aluminium ladders, scaffolding rental, installation and dismantling.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 58 137 5601 (secondary +971 50 926 8038)
- Email: sales@alcoascaffolding.com, info@alcoascaffolding.com
- Address: Ar Rahmah 4 St., Musaffah 37, Al Mantaqah As Sinai'yah 1 Street - Office number 11, 1st Floor, Abu Dhabi, UAE
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–6pm
- Website: https://alcoascaffolding.com
